neighboring_unit_entries.title: Weighted prime-power counting as the inverse transform of log zeta
neighboring_unit_entries.why_material: The source defines a midpoint convention for the prime count, forms a weighted sum over prime powers, identifies log zeta divided by s as its Mellin transform, derives a vertical-line inverse using Fourier theory including the mean value at jumps, and identifies why direct integration of separated zero and gamma terms fails.

neighboring_unit_entries.title: Gamma and zero contributions are compressed to one inverse-transform kernel

This converts a heterogeneous decomposition into one reusable contour calculation.

related_synthesis_entries.claim: The root product is connected to a weighted prime-power count by inverse transform; a failed direct termwise route is repaired, each factor is evaluated with case and branch control, the zero series is ordered, and a squarefree alternating inversion recovers the prime count.
